title: Antibacterial potential, DNA binding and molecular docking investigations of newly green synthesized zinc oxide/chitosan/vancomycin nanocomposite using Bacillus licheniformis ATCC 4527 against some drug-resistant bacteria.
authors: El-Salamony, Shimaa M; Baka, Zakaria A M; Abou-Dobara, Mohamed I; Salama, Hanaa M; El-Zahed, Mohamed M
one_liner_zh: 该研究主要聚焦绿色合成ZnO/壳聚糖/万古霉素纳米复合物的抗菌活性，虽含CT-DNA结合和分子对接，但对象为小分子-核酸及抗菌靶点，非TF-DNA互作体系，方法为常规对接，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The increasing crisis of multidrug-resistant (MDR) bacteria requires the creation of new, highly effective, and safe antibacterial agents. This study introduces a simple and cost-effective green synthesis method for a novel zinc oxide/chitosan/vancomycin (ZnO/CS/VA) nanocomposite to improve antibacterial activity against priority MDR strains. Zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) were biosynthesized using Bacillus licheniformis ATCC 4527 and then combined with vancomycin (VA) and chitosan (CS) in an environmentally friendly process. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), X-ray diffraction (XRD), ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy (UV-Vis), and zeta potential studies were conducted to validate and characterize the production of ZnO/CS/VA. The antibacterial activity of the nanoparticles was tested against several multidrug-resistant (MDR) strains, including Bacillus cereus HES3, methicillin-resistant S. aureus (MRSA), Escherichia coli D8, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Klebsiella pneumoniae H4. Further assessment included molecular docking interactions with E. coli (PDB: 3T88) and MRSA (PDB: 4DKI) targets, CT-DNA binding, and cytotoxicity testing on the Vero cell line. Characterization confirmed the successful formation of the nanocomposite, revealing ZnO nanoparticles ranging from 33.24 to 69.11 nm and high stability (zeta potential: -17.78 mV). The ZnO/CS/VA nanocomposite exhibited superior dose-dependent antibacterial activity compared to ZnO nanoparticles or VA alone against all tested MDR strains, including MRSA and E. coli D8. Molecular docking demonstrated strong binding, with scores ranging from -0.7 to -10.85 kcal/mol. The nanocomposite exhibited a hypochromism when interacting with CT-DNA, suggesting intercalation. Importantly, the CC50 values of ZnO NPs and ZnO/CS/VA against Vero cells were 146.62+/-1.03 and 162.86+/-1.07 mug/mL, respectively, indicating their high level of safety. CONCLUSIONS: The green-synthesized ZnO/CS/VA nanocomposite is a promising alternative candidate for treating various MDR bacterial infections. It offers utility in biomedical and pharmaceutical applications due to its high efficacy and low cytotoxicity.
abstract_zh: 背景：多重耐药（MDR）细菌日益严重的危机要求开发新型、高效且安全的抗菌剂。本研究介绍了一种简单且成本低廉的绿色合成方法，用于制备新型氧化锌/壳聚糖/万古霉素（ZnO/CS/VA）纳米复合材料，以提高对重点多重耐药菌株的抗菌活性。利用地衣芽孢杆菌ATCC 4527生物合成氧化锌纳米颗粒（ZnO NPs），随后通过环保工艺与万古霉素（VA）和壳聚糖（CS）结合。采用透射电子显微镜（TEM）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）、X射线衍射（XRD）、紫外-可见光谱（UV-Vis）和Zeta电位研究来验证和表征ZnO/CS/VA的生成。测试了纳米颗粒对多种多重耐药（MDR）菌株的抗菌活性，包括蜡状芽孢杆菌HES3、耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）、大肠杆菌D8、铜绿假单胞菌和肺炎克雷伯菌H4。进一步评估包括与大肠杆菌（PDB：3T88）和MRSA（PDB：4DKI）靶点的分子对接相互作用、CT-DNA结合以及Vero细胞系上的细胞毒性测试。表征确认了纳米复合材料的成功形成，显示ZnO纳米颗粒尺寸范围为33.24至69.11 nm，且具有高稳定性（Zeta电位：-17.78 mV）。与单独的ZnO纳米颗粒或万古霉素相比，ZnO/CS/VA纳米复合材料对所有测试的MDR菌株（包括MRSA和大肠杆菌D8）表现出更优的剂量依赖性抗菌活性。分子对接显示强结合，得分范围为-0.7至-10.85 kcal/mol。纳米复合材料在与CT-DNA相互作用时表现出减色效应，提示嵌入作用。重要的是，ZnO NPs和ZnO/CS/VA对Vero细胞的CC50值分别为146.62±1.03和162.86±1.07 μg/mL，表明其高安全性。结论：绿色合成的ZnO/CS/VA纳米复合材料是治疗各种MDR细菌感染的有前景的替代候选材料。由于其高效能和低细胞毒性，在生物医学和制药应用中具有实用性。
